definitions.explanation: the physical telephone device or handset, as distinct from the service or act of calling

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{電話機|でんわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{電話機|でんわき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{受話器|じゅわき}→受話器：15742_juwaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (telephone) and ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine, device). While ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ can refer to both the device and the act of calling, {電話機|でんわき} specifically refers to the physical telephone device itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電話機|でんわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a telephone
- {電話機|でんわき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}→故障：01405_koshou⟧: telephone malfunction
- ⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧{電話機|でんわき}: landline telephone
- ⟦{公衆|こうしゅう}→公衆：11660_koushuu⟧{電話機|でんわき}: public telephone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧: telephone — the general word, refers to both the device and phone calls
- ⟦{受話器|じゅわき}→受話器：15742_juwaki⟧: receiver, handset — the part you hold to your ear
- ⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧: mobile phone — portable telephone
